text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: Phew~ That bath felt wonderful.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: ...Huh, Craft? What's wrong? Why are you outside...?

text_block_list.name: Line Craft
text_block_list.text: Cesa~~rio~~...! "That thing" is inside the room~~...

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: One got in, didn't it... a stink bug.

text_block_list.name: Line Craft
text_block_list.text: It's been perched on the ceiling the entire time... So... please help me again!

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: Ahaha, leave it to me! I'll give it a try.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: There, there, hop on over here~ I'll escort you outside~

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Bzzz... BZZZZZZ!!)

text_block_list.name: Line Craft
text_block_list.text: !? Eeeeek~~!! It's flying this waaaay~~!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (THUD!! SLAM!! CLICK!!)

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: Ah! Opening the door let it out into the hallway...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (BZZZZZZ...!!)

text_block_list.name: Line Craft
text_block_list.text: I'm so sorry~~!! It got out into the hall... What do we do, what do we do...?!

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: No, you couldn't help it. More importantly, we have to deal with that stink bug.

text_block_list.name: Line Craft
text_block_list.text: ...!! I-I'll chase it too...!

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: ...Are you sure? You don't have to push yourself, you know?

text_block_list.name: Line Craft
text_block_list.text: But it escaped because of me. I can't just leave everything to you...!

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: Craft... In that case...

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: Facing your fears head-on—truly commendable. I know you can conquer this.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: I shall lend you my strength to assist your triumph. ...First, let us alert the other students nearby.

text_block_list.name: Line Craft
text_block_list.text: Cesario...! —Yeah!

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: —Alright, we've cornered it. Now all we have to do is guide it toward that open window...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (BZZZZZZZZ!!!!)

text_block_list.name: Line Craft
text_block_list.text: It's coming back toward me again?! Eeeeek!!

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: Do not falter, Craft!!

text_block_list.name: Line Craft
text_block_list.text: —Kh!

text_block_list.name: Line Craft
text_block_list.text: T-Taaaake thiiiiiis!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Bzz-wha?! Bzzz...!!)

text_block_list.name: Line Craft
text_block_list.text: I-It went outside... ...Phew~~~~...

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: Well done, Craft. Your sheer fighting spirit altered the stink bug's course.

text_block_list.name: Line Craft
text_block_list.text: No, it's because you cheered me on... Thank you, Cesario.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: During lunch break, I spotted Cesario and Line Craft chatting in the cafeteria.

text_block_list.name: Line Craft
text_block_list.text: Yesterday was terrifying~... Just thinking about it gives me the chills~

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: You really did your best, Craft. Good girl, good girl.
